projects.title: AI-Powered SDN Security
projects.tagline: An SDN controller that learns normal traffic and reacts to threats on its own.
projects.summary: Next-generation network security platform combining Software-Defined Networking with machine learning for intelligent threat detection, adaptive firewall rules and automated incident response.

details.heading: Goals
items: Learn a baseline of normal traffic and flag anomalies in real time
Push adaptive flow rules to the switches without human intervention
Dashboard for live traffic, alerts and model decisions

details.heading: Roadmap
items: Collect and label traffic datasets in Mininet
Train and compare models (Random Forest, Isolation Forest…)
Integrate the model with the Ryu controller
Evaluate against DDoS and scanning scenarios

projects.title: Enterprise Supplier Management
projects.tagline: Full-stack Flask app for suppliers, procurement and automated reporting.
projects.summary: A web application built during my internship at UPF to manage suppliers and procurement, with role-based access, automated PDF/Excel reports and data-visualisation dashboards — packaged as a Windows executable.

details.heading: What it does
items: Supplier, contract and order management with role-based access control
One-click PDF (ReportLab) and Excel (Pandas) reports
Dashboards built with matplotlib and seaborn
Google Apps Script integration for spreadsheet workflows

details.heading: Delivery
items: SQLite database — zero-config deployment
Packaged with PyInstaller for one-click installs on Windows

projects.title: SDN Attack Detection System
projects.tagline: Real-time ICMP-flood detection with automatic blocking and email alerts.
projects.summary: My final-year project: an OpenFlow controller built on Ryu that monitors traffic in a Mininet topology, detects ICMP flood attacks in real time, blocks the source with dynamic flow rules and alerts administrators by email.

details.heading: How it works
items: Threshold-based detection on per-source packet rates in a sliding time window
Dynamic flow rules block malicious sources instantly
SMTP alerts with attack details; structured JSON logs for forensics

details.heading: Stack
items: Python 3, Ryu SDN framework, OpenFlow 1.3, Mininet

details.heading: Testing
items: ICMP floods from 50 to 10,000 packets/s, multi-source and low-and-slow attacks
TCP SYN and UDP floods used for protocol-specific checks

details.heading: Next steps
items: ML-based anomaly detection (see AI-Powered SDN Security)
Behavioural profiling and threat-intelligence feeds
